glosses: unbridled, ungovernable, uncontrollable, unrestrained (free from constraint, uninhibited)

glosses: Not governable; unable to be governed.

examples.text: The concern about ungovernability in the United States often takes the form of complaints about “single-issue” politics and the limited influence and discipline of American political parties. Thus our next question is, Why are some modern societies to some degree ungovernable?

glosses: Unable to be managed or controlled.

examples.text: a man with an ungovernable temper

But now this visit of my soft warm hand in those so sensible parts had put every thing into such ungovernable fury that, disdaining all further preluding, and taking advantage of my commodious posture, he made the storm fall where I scarce patiently expected, and where he was sure to lay it

glosses: Not able to be controlled, contained or governed.

examples.text: She got the uncontrollable urge for some chocolate.

examples.text: The party was a scene of unrestrained debauchery.
